# FlowBoard

> FlowBoard is a simple web app for organizing tasks on drag-and-drop kanban boards.

## What it does
- Create multiple boards, each with To Do, In Progress and Done columns
- Add, edit, prioritize, search and filter cards; drag cards between columns
- Sign in with email and password, magic link, or sign up for a free account

## Pages
- [Sign in / sign up](https://flowboard.example/): the only public page
- Boards (/boards) require an account and are not indexable
